blocks.text: THE PAST IS THE FUTURE AGAIN— ‘‘The most wonderful event since Jesus came to earth 2,000 years ago is soon to take place; The Translation of the Saints! Some of the same signs that were occuring in the heavens and the earth when Jesus came the first time are absolutely reoccuring today! According to the signs we are definitely living in the latter time of our age!’’ — Eccl. 3:1, ‘“To everything there is a season, and a time to ‘every purpose’ under the heaven!’’ — Vr. 15, ‘‘That which hath been is NOW, and that which is to be hath already BEEN; and God requireth that which is PAST!’’ — Job 8:9, (‘‘For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:) — To God we are living in His past as we are going forth in our future because He is eternal He already knows what shall be and has prepared for it!’’ — ‘‘Also remember God healed Hezekiah (Isa. 38:5-8) and added 15 years to his life. And the Lord said, I shall give thee a sign. Behold I will bring again ‘the shadow’ of the degrees, which is gone down in the ‘sun dial’ of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.”’

CONTINUING— ‘‘Evidently besides a sign God corrected something in our galaxy, but it could also have something to do with the future. — One thing we know, time went backwards. How long is not quite certain; but when it came time for the king to die death passed over and God’s promise was true! — The sun dial is connected to time, and the number 10 is used! — Dan. chap. 10 revealed Daniel’s answer was delayed 21 days. And Dan. 11:37-45, showed it had to do with the ending of days and the coming of the Lord!’’ — And in Matt. 25:1-9, “tells of the midnight hour and the return of the Lord. (Vr. 10) — Rev. 10:1-7, speaks of the 7 Thunders, about time itself, and the coming of the Lord! — So we also know I day was lost during the time of Joshua!’’ (Josh. 10:12-14) — ‘10 — the ordinal number of completion! 1 through 10 completes the digits and begins a new series! — So at the end of the age, at the time of the Translation we can be sure that God again will do something very amazing as we are caught up to meet Him! — And as we know Hezekiah had a new beginning and he also knew exactly how long he would live, 15 more years! — Very few people have been given that type of privilege! — But the elect at the end of the age will know almost the time (season) of the Translation!’’ — ‘‘Here is another mystery, time to us is not like time to the Lord! II Peter 3:8, But beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day!’’ — ‘‘But we do know in God’s eternal sight and according to the signs our time is almost up! — My opinion is that our generation shall see Him!’’

THE PAST IS THE FUTURE CONTINUING— “‘In the above paragraph I printed a little more than intended, so let’s get back to our subject. — Ecc. 3:1,15, That which hath been is NOW; and that which is to be hath already BEEN; and God requireth that which is PAST!’’ — ‘‘Let’s check when the first World War began we see it was the beginning of sorrows in a minor way! Just before this the great Comet appeared. Before and after the war two presidents died in office!’’ — ‘In the 1920’s the nation witnessed the most immoral sight it had ever seen along with prosperity! — This preceeded the 1929 crash! Followed by famine in parts of the world and the United States suffered droughts and the great Dust Bowl!’’ — ‘‘At this time was the rising of 3 dictators, Adolf Hitler and 2 others. And within a decade the man who had promised peace had brought on World War II. — Also Hitler was symbolic of what was yet to come . . . the value of his currency was called ‘the mark!’ He gave each Jew ‘a number’ on their hand or arm! He had the ‘crooked cross’ called the Swastika, etc. — Now let’s check the past with our age below!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘First like in those days we have also had several presidents die in office. Halley’s Comet has appeared again! — We are in the most immoral plight that the world has ever seen. Our generation is entering the beginning of sorrows! — Storm clouds of the Great Tribulation is not far away!’’ — ‘‘We have also had several wars! Also we have been in prosperity; we’ve had an inflationary depression in the 80’s and a stock market crash! — These are only minor warnings!’’ — ‘‘Also back in the 20’s the underworld began with Al Capone, and the drug ‘alcohol’ was a craze at that time! Now, the underworld today is again saturating the nation with dope, cocaine and etc. Like alcohol in those days, they are passing laws to prevent drugs from being sold! Now during that time veneral diseases broke out everywhere, and condoms were used. Now in our time of the drug craze and gay society the disease of AIDS has broken out! — In almost every news broadcast the doctors were telling the people to return to condoms for protection! So we see what is in the past will return again even though it’s in a different way!’’

CONTINUING— “‘In the 1920’s drinking became so terrible that they outlawed it, then they turned around and okayed it! — So in our day they have outlawed drugs and now they are talking about making it legal! — Some say this will never occur. One thing for certain, it will make it worse! — But in one way it is legally occurring. For those who are using drugs turn themselves in they will give them replacement drugs (methadone and etc.) which is almost the same as what they were using!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘During the late 20’s and 30’s there were an extreme amount of bank robberies we also see an even greater barrage of this today. And they had many bank failures then, and we also have many bank failures now!’’ — ‘‘Here is another sign the past is catching up with our day. In the late 20’s and 30’s the Pentecostal Amie McPherson was in the headlines during the late part of her ministry; and it was called the scandal of their age! Now in our time we see the Pentecostal scandals concerning the PTL and other evangelists in gossip and scandal! — These are all signs! — Right now we are in the middle of a world famine and like the 1930’s the United States is suffering a severe drought, some states are becoming like the earlier dust bowls! — Remember it was during a time like this that we have been speaking of that Adolf Hitler and 2 more leaders rose, so we can expect the rising of the anti-christ and two more world leaders with him!’’ — (Check my past scrolls for more information.)

CONTINUING— ‘“‘The anti-christ will promise peace like Hitler did, and will give them a mark and number, but instead of peace, like the latter did will finally plunge them into the Battle of Armageddon! — Blood will pour!’ — ‘‘Also during the time of World War II the atomic bomb was used, and during Armageddon the atomic hydrogen bomb will be used and even newer weapons! So we see that which is in the past will come again, but only in an enlarged and intensified way!”’ CONTINUING PROPHECY — ‘‘Here is some more information! — Also by looking around us now our signs are pointing to some later severe economic conditions again like in the late 20’s-30’s, probably as the anti-christ rises to power, promising to restore prosperity!’’ — ‘‘In those days of past they also had their false messiahs and false prophets, like Father Divine and prophet Jones and etc.!’’ — ‘‘They had occults, black magic and like Houdini and so forth! — And others tried to contact the dead, spirit phenomenan, clairvoyance and familiar spirits!’’ — ‘‘Outrageous dress wear then and now! They had nudity in their theater plays, prostitutes were seen everywhere in the 20’s! — Even the movie stars portrayed these type roles! — In our time they have total perversion and rated R and X movies, sex orgies and horror films of bloodshed and violence!’’ — ‘‘Films showing witchcraft, the occult by special effects luring them into new dimensions taking over the youths’ minds!’’ — ‘‘Also in those days we remember the kidnappings of children occurred like in the Lindbergh case! That was only forerunning what was to occur in our day when scores of children come up missing! Some are used in porno movies, some in prostitution, some are killed and etc.’’ — ‘‘Our generation is climaxing!’’ — “Great quakes in early 1900’s!’’ — ‘‘Great quakes coming again!”’ CONTINUING — ‘‘As the age closes out satan will try to imitate God’s works and confuse the people to keep them off balance! — Some today are not able to distinguish what is of God and what is not! — In fact, there is considerable imitation of divine gifts today, even as in Moses’ day! When Moses performed a miracle, magicians would imitate it! When Aaron cast down his rod and it became a serpent, the magicians did likewise (Ex. 7:10-12). When he lifted up his rod and turned the waters to blood, ‘the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh’s heart was hardened.’ ’’ (Ex. 8:18-19) — ‘‘When Aaron’s rod caused frogs to come up and cover the land, the magicians were able to do it too! (Ex. 8:6-7) — With so much sorcery and witchcraft prevalent in these days, people will confuse the power of God with the power of satan! Under such circumstances their hearts will be hardened as was Pharaoh’s rather than being brought to repentance!’’ — Finally the sorcerers were limited and Moses won! CONTINUING PROPHECY — ‘‘We’ve read about this case in magazines! . . . But let’s print this from an evangelist at the time it occurred!’’. . . Quote: ‘‘The truth is, psychic phenomena have been manifested to such a degree, including materializations and dematerializations, that people are expecting almost anything to happen. There is the well-documented case of the vanishing boy in Manila who received a great deal of publicity a few years ago! The phenomenon baffled authorities until the demon was cast out of the lad by the power of God. The family then became Christians. Now, if satan had the power to do this once, he can and will likely do it again! He will mimic everything the Lord does, and in that way confuse people. The fact is, the anti-christ when he comes will himself demonstrate preternatural power: and will claim that his power exceeds that of the Christian’s God. (Rev. 13:3-5) — Indeed, he will manifest great signs and ‘lying wonders’ which the Scriptures tell us will deceive the inhabitants of the earth. He will demonstrate his own power by calling fire down from heaven! Besides supernaturally — also by atomic or new weapons!’’ — *‘(Rev. 13:13) — (II Thess. 2:9) — ‘‘But Jesus’ power is much greater — and He will protect and take the elect up soon!’’
